page.title: Shipments
page.description: Shipments assigned to your agency for pickup and delivery
page.searchLabel: Search by order #, customer, product, or tracking #
page.searchHint: Keep typing — search needs at least {{count}} characters.
page.filterDescription: Filters apply across every page of your shipments.
page.emptyNoShipments: No shipments in this category yet

table.trackAgent: Track this agent on the live map

actions.needsAcceptedOffer: An agent must accept the offer first

autoAssign.label: Auto-assign
autoAssign.tooltipOn: New shipments are offered to your nearest eligible agent automatically. Change this in Settings → Preferences.
autoAssign.tooltipOff: New shipments wait for you to assign them. Turn on auto-assignment in Settings → Preferences.

reject.title: Reject shipment
reject.description: Decline this delivery before pickup. If an agent has accepted it, they are released, and a fee change still waiting on the vendor is withdrawn. The vendor is notified with your reason so they can reroute it to another agency.
reject.messagePlaceholderRequired: Explain why you're rejecting this shipment…
reject.messagePlaceholderOptional: Add any details for the vendor…

assignment.title: Agent Assignment
assignment.codHint: Cash-on-delivery shipments need an agent to accept before pickup — they hold the cash and the offer is gated on their cash-risk profile.
assignment.codHintAmount: Whoever accepts will be holding {{amount}} in cash — the offer is gated on their cash-risk profile and re-checked when they accept.
assignment.broadcastExplainer: Agents are being offered this shipment nearest-first, one every couple of minutes, with earlier offers left standing — the first to accept gets it. If nobody accepts after two rounds you'll be notified so you can assign manually. Stopping withdraws every live offer.
assignment.autoAssignStarted: Searching — offered to the nearest agent first.
assignment.offersWithdrawn: Offers withdrawn — the shipment is back in your queue.
assignment.handoverInProgress: A handover is in progress — the replacement agent has been offered the shipment.
assignment.notOfferable: No agent can be offered in this shipment's current state.
assignment.handoverFallback: Fallback location — original point could not be resolved.
assignment.candidatesEmptyHint: Agents are left out silently when they are at capacity, paused, or outside this delivery’s area.
assignment.candidatesEmptyCodHint: For a cash-on-delivery run, agents are also left out silently when they aren't verified yet, or when their cash limit is too low — a new contract starts at zero, which removes the agent from every COD list until you raise it.

reassignDialog.title: Reassign shipment
reassignDialog.description: Release the current agent and offer this shipment to a replacement. This is an audited action.
reassignDialog.agentRequiredHint: The parcel has left the agency, so you must name the replacement.
reassignDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Agent's bike broke down on Rue Joffre
reassignDialog.overrideHint: Leave blank to use the automatic handover point (the previous agent's last known location, the original pickup, or your HQ — depending on the shipment's status).
reassignDialog.success: Shipment released and offered to the replacement.

coverageForce.title: This delivery is outside the regions in {{name}}'s contract.
coverageForce.explainer: You can still send it to them. The offer will be marked as outside their regions, and they can accept or decline it as usual.
coverageForce.codNote: This is a cash-on-delivery shipment: sending anyway also lets it past this agent's cash limit.

offerFlags.codLimitForced: Sent above the agent's COD limit

money.codSnapshotHint: Cash the agent takes from the customer at the door.
money.codProjectedHint: Nobody has taken this delivery yet, so this is a projection of the cash due at the door — item prices × quantity. It's locked in the moment an agent accepts.
money.codProjectedCaption: Projected — no agent has taken this yet
money.deliveryFeeOnlyHint: The customer paid the items online and hands your agent the delivery fee in cash. It's your money — no commission and no COD handling fee on it.
money.prepaidCaption: Paid online — nothing to collect at the door.
money.estimateCaveat: An estimate: the agent's split is read again when the money is actually paid out, so changing their contract before delivery changes this.
money.finalCaveat: Final: these are the amounts actually credited for this delivery.
money.returnedCodZero: A returned cash-on-delivery shipment earns nothing: no cash was collected, so there is no fee, agent share or COD fee.
money.orderValue: Order value {{amount}} — the whole order, which can split across several shipments and agencies.

unavailable.no_agent: Your net can't be quoted until an agent accepts — their contracted cut comes out of the delivery fee, so any figure shown now would only drop once somebody takes it.
unavailable.no_agency_policy: Your delivery pricing isn't configured, so there's no fee to divide.

detail.deliveryProofNone: No proof photo was recorded for this delivery.

review.title: Rate this delivery
review.explainer: This rates the agent who carried the parcel and feeds their trust score. It does not affect your own agency rating, which comes from your customers.
review.prosePending: Because you have written something, this will be checked by a moderator before it counts. A rating on its own counts straight away.
review.submittedHeld: Submitted — a moderator will review your comments before it counts.
review._statusComment: The three outcomes of a review, shared by the shipment panel and the roll-up under Agents → Reviews. `badge` is the one-word form beside an icon; `title` and `body` are the full statement. `pending` must never read as a failure — it is what attaching comments buys you, and nothing is required of the author.

published.title: Live
published.body: It counts towards the agent's rating. It never moves your own agency rating — that comes from your customers' reviews.

pending.title: Held for moderation
pending.body: You attached comments, so a moderator checks them before this counts. Nothing is needed from you: you do not have to resubmit, and there is nothing to chase.

rejected.title: Declined by moderation
rejected.body: A moderator declined this review, so it counts for nothing — the rating included. It cannot be appealed, and this delivery cannot be rated again.

mine.title: Your review
mine.ratingOnly: You rated this delivery without writing anything.
mine.noChange: A review cannot be edited or withdrawn once it is in.
mine.notFound: You have already rated this delivery, and a rating cannot be changed once it is in.

rollup.heldBannerBody: You attached comments to them, so a moderator checks them before they count. Nothing is needed from you.
rollup.filterDescription: Narrow to what became of each review.
rollup.empty: You have not rated a delivery yet
rollup.emptyBody: Open a delivered shipment and rate the run. Your rating feeds the agent's trust score — it never moves your own agency rating.
rollup.emptyFilteredBody: Clear the filter to see every review you have written.

codLimitForce.title: This shipment would take {{name}} past their cash-on-delivery limit.
codLimitForce.sliceBinds: The limit on your contract with them is what refuses.
codLimitForce.poolBinds: Their own COD pool is what refuses — it is lower than the limit on your contract.
codLimitForce.explainer: You can still assign it. The offer will be marked as sent above their limit, and they will hold more cash than the limit allows until they deposit.

bulkAssign.selectPage: Select the shipments on this page that can be offered
bulkAssign.limitReached: That's the limit: up to {{max}} shipments per batch.
bulkAssign.title: Offer shipments to one agent
bulkAssign.description: Each shipment becomes its own offer to the agent you pick, checked exactly as if you offered it alone. The agent gets one notification for the whole batch.
bulkAssign.atCapacity: Free slots for {{name}}: {{free}}. Shipments that could be offered: {{requested}}. Nothing was offered. Remove {{excess}}, then send again.
bulkAssign.atCapacityNone: {{name}} has no free slot right now. Nothing was offered.
bulkAssign.forceTitle_one: {{count}} shipment was refused only for this agent's cash limit or contract regions.
bulkAssign.forceTitle_other: {{count}} shipments were refused only for this agent's cash limit or contract regions.
bulkAssign.forceExplainer: You can send just those anyway. Each offer will be marked as forced, and the agent can accept or decline it as usual. Shipments already offered are not sent again.

deliveryFee.title: Delivery fee
deliveryFee.dialogDescription: For this shipment only. Whoever pays the delivery answers it: the vendor, or — when the customer pays delivery — the customer, and a lower fee then applies at once. Pickup is blocked while an answer is awaited.
deliveryFee.dialogDescriptionVendor: For this shipment only. The shop pays this delivery, so the vendor must approve. Pickup is blocked until they answer.
deliveryFee.dialogDescriptionCustomer: For this shipment only. The customer pays this delivery: a lower fee applies at once; a higher one waits for the customer, and pickup is blocked until they answer.
deliveryFee.reasonPlaceholder: Why does this parcel need a different fee? Whoever pays the delivery sees this.
deliveryFee.proposed: Fee change sent to the vendor.
deliveryFee.proposedToCustomer: Fee change sent to the customer.
deliveryFee.pickupBlocked: A fee change is waiting for an answer — pickup is blocked until then.
deliveryFee.pickupBlockedVendor: Waiting for the vendor to answer a fee change — pickup is blocked until they do.
deliveryFee.pickupBlockedCustomer: Waiting for the customer to answer a fee change — pickup is blocked until they do.
deliveryFee.pickupBlockedTopup: The customer accepted the new fee and still has to pay the difference — pickup is blocked until they do.
deliveryFee.afterRejection: The vendor rejected the new fee. Propose once more, or decline the delivery so they can pick another agency.
deliveryFee.afterRejectionHandover: The vendor rejected the new fee. During a handover the delivery can no longer be declined: propose once more, or carry it at the original fee.
deliveryFee.afterCustomerRejection: The customer declined the new fee. Carry it at the original fee, propose once more, or decline the delivery.
deliveryFee.afterCustomerRejectionHandover: The customer declined the new fee. During a handover the delivery can no longer be declined: propose once more, or carry it at the original fee.

breakdown.title: How the posted fee was built
breakdown.capApplied: Capped at your maximum fee per shipment
breakdown.flatFallback: You had no pricing set, so the platform's flat fee was used.
breakdown.overridden: An approved fee change replaces this posted price.

deliveryFee.topupAwaiting: The customer accepted and owes {{amount}} more. The new fee applies — and pickup unblocks — once they pay.
deliveryFee.appliedDirectly: Applied straight away: a lower fee on a customer-paid delivery needs no approval.
deliveryFee.changeAgencyNote: Raised by Wi-Mall when the vendor moved this parcel to you. You're paid your price whatever the answer.
deliveryFee.combinedNote: Your answer to the customer's combined-price request.
deliveryFee.withdrawnDeclined: Withdrawn when you declined the delivery
deliveryFee.withdrawnAgentLeft: Withdrawn — the agent left the job

validation.reasonMin: Give a reason of at least {{min}} characters.

combined.title: Combined price requests
combined.description: Customers asking you for one lower price on several parcels from the same checkout.
combined.entryOpen_one: {{count}} combined-price request is waiting for your answer
combined.entryOpen_other: {{count}} combined-price requests are waiting for your answer
combined.filterDescription: Open requests are the ones waiting for your answer.
combined.emptyOpenBody: When a customer asks you for one price on several parcels from the same checkout, the request appears here.

respond.title: Lower the delivery fees
respond.description: Enter a lower fee for each parcel you want to discount; leave a field empty to keep that parcel's fee. Each lower fee applies straight away — an online order is refunded the difference, a cash order's amount to collect drops.
respond.atLeastOne: Lower at least one fee, or decline the request instead.
respond.success: Lower fees applied — the customer has been told.
respond.partial: Applied to {{applied}} of {{total}} parcels. These couldn't be changed:

declineDialog.title: Decline this request?
declineDialog.description: The fees stay as they are, and the customer is told you declined.
declineDialog.notePlaceholder: E.g. These parcels go to different towns.
